feat(dynamic): add binary build pipeline (#26)

* feat(osprey): add binary build spec

Pin source commits, lockfile digests, toolchains, targets, and compiled capabilities in the shared cross-language contract.

* feat(hawk): add binary build jobs

Persist scoped build requests and expose idempotent management API jobs with isolated worker inputs, artifact digests, and bounded logs. Grant the corresponding app permissions through session projections and publish the generated client contract.

The migration adds queued/running/succeeded/failed state and grants build permissions to the platform owner role.

* feat(robin): add binary build page

Add permission-gated build navigation, queue form, polling history, artifact status, bounded logs, and localized management copy for the Hawk build contract.

* fix(dynamic): harden binary build flow

Harden build isolation, recovery, and artifact handling.

Validate optimistic revisions and cross-platform JSON number safety.

* fix(hawk): harden dynamic build flow

Add release write permissions and fenced build leases. Keep the dispatcher continuous, isolate build caches, validate component contracts, and publish verified releases in Swan.

* fix(dynamic): close review gaps

Harden artifact and lease handling, constrain component schemas, validate Swan renderer fallback, and keep generated-client drift checks free of tool caches.

* fix(dynamic): align review boundaries

Validate component schemas at registration and release time, enforce the shared Shell version format, and make OpenAPI checks launch their explicit build output.

* fix(hawk): fence build process groups

Terminate command process groups when leases expire or commands fail, and bound Shell version components consistently across Osprey, Hawk, and Swan.

* fix(hawk): clean build process groups

Keep a synchronous group-kill guard across command cancellation and clean background descendants even after a successful parent exit.

* fix(hawk): hold build leases through cleanup

Keep the heartbeat alive until cleanup and terminal persistence finish so stale recovery cannot reclaim a job during its finalization window.

* fix(build): harden binary artifacts

Bind build inputs to app metadata and signer-derived release keys; hash logical manifests without lease paths.

* fix(build): close binary build review gaps

Use registry metadata and signer-derived values for publishable builds, preflight duplicate migration versions, and expose the metadata update API.

* fix(osprey): align binary build validation

Keep Rust and Dart binary-build errors and selection rules in parity, and exercise the canonical component contract in the database test.

* fix(build): snapshot metadata and isolate signing

Freeze App metadata at queue time and keep publishable signing in Hawk-owned signer processes so source builds never receive signing secrets.

* fix(osprey): publish generated JSON schemas

Generate every v1 schema as a checked-in JSON contract and normalize cross-schema references for downstream validators.

* fix(build): harden sandbox and iOS export

Require an isolated source build before publishable signing, export iOS IPAs with the configured profile, and keep legacy migration rows explicitly unsnapshotted.

* fix(build): isolate sandbox processes

Separate source builds from host processes and signing paths with PID and network namespaces, read-only toolchains, and per-job writable caches.

* fix(contract): reject null artifact kind

Keep generated Dart decoding aligned with Rust and OpenAPI by defaulting only when artifactKind is absent.

* fix(build): harden sandbox inputs

Require Bubblewrap and explicit FVM paths, isolate writable SDK cache, stabilize idempotent builds, and migrate iOS bundle IDs off underscores.
